dream: The wedge lay thin inside the hot card's belly. I pressed the flat top down, feeling the air swell to wet paper weight. The wide anchor slid, refusing to hold. The hammer bit down, forcing the slip into the dark. A moss hung from nowhere, dripping onto the roof. The air grew heavy enough to crush the dot safe within the frame. I woke the wedge by pressing hard until the lazy anchor stopped its drift, just before the stack melted.
